description: This file defines utility functions and constants for managing message channels, including normalization, listing, and type guards for different channel types within a chat application.

methods.name: isGatewayCliClient
methods.description: Checks if the given client info represents a Gateway CLI client.

methods.name: isOperatorUiClient
methods.description: Checks if the given client info represents an Operator UI client.

methods.name: isBrowserOperatorUiClient
methods.description: Checks if the given client info represents a Browser Operator UI client.

methods.name: isInternalMessageChannel
methods.description: Checks if a raw string corresponds to the internal message channel.

methods.name: isWebchatClient
methods.description: Checks if the client info indicates a Webchat client.

methods.name: normalizeMessageChannel
methods.description: Normalizes a raw string into a message channel identifier.

methods.name: listDeliverableMessageChannels
methods.description: Returns a list of all deliverable message channels.

methods.name: listGatewayMessageChannels
methods.description: Returns a list of all gateway message channels.

methods.name: listGatewayAgentChannelAliases
methods.description: Returns a list of gateway agent channel aliases.

methods.name: listGatewayAgentChannelValues
methods.description: Returns a list of all gateway agent channel values.

methods.name: isGatewayMessageChannel
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid gateway message channel.

methods.name: isDeliverableMessageChannel
methods.description: Checks if a string is a valid deliverable message channel.

methods.name: resolveGatewayMessageChannel
methods.description: Resolves a raw string to a gateway message channel if valid.

methods.name: resolveMessageChannel
methods.description: Resolves primary or fallback strings into a message channel.

methods.name: isMarkdownCapableMessageChannel
methods.description: Checks if a message channel supports markdown.
